content: Enterekêro za Salomoni
Erhi Salomoni ayûsa okushenga, omuliro gwamanuka emalunga gwasingônola enterekêro y’ensirîra n’ezindi nterekêro, n’irenge lya Nyamuzinda lyayunjula enyumpa yoshi.
Abadâhwa barhankacihashire okujà omu nyumpa ya Nyamubâho, bulya irenge lya Nyamubâho lyamayunjuza enyumpa ya Nyamubâho.

Bene Israheli boshi erhi babona omuliro n’irenge biyandagalira oku nyumpa bafukamiriza, bayunama akamalanga kahwêra oku idaho, baharâmya banakuza Nyamubâho bakaziderha mpu: «Bulya ali mwinjà, bulya obuzigire bwâge buli bw’ensiku n’amango!»
Mwâmi n’olubaga loshi lwarherekêra enterekêro zâbo embere za Nyamubâho.
Mwâmi Salomoni abâna nterekêro, nkâfu bihumbi ikumi na bibirhi na bibuzi bihumbi igana na makumi abirhi. Ntyo, mwâmi n’olubaga loshi bajira ntyo olwôla lusiku lwa okugisha aka-Nyamuzinda.

Abadâhwa bakazâgiyôrha bali omu mikolo yâbo, na abaleviti n’ebizihwa byâbo, bakazizihira Nyamubâho lulya lulanga Daudi ajiraga lwa okukuza Nyamubâho, «bulya obonjo bwâge buli bw’ensiku n’amango!» Bo bakazâgiyimba zirya nnanga Daudi asingaga. Abadâhwa bakazâg’ibûha emishekera embere zâbo, nabo bene Israheli boshi bali bayimanzire.

Salomoni agisha endalâla y’ahantu hatagatîfu, ahâli embere ly’enyumpa ya Nyamubâho; bulya amarherekêrera ahôla enterekêro z’ensirîra n’eza amashushi g’enterekêro z’omurhûla, bulya oluhêrero ajiraga lurhankahashirija kwo ezôla nterekêro zoshi z’ensirîra, ez’enkalangè n’ez’amashushi.
Salomoni ajira olusiku lukulu mango ga nsiku nda, n’Israheli yêshi haguma naye: mbugânano ya bantu banji bakazâg’irhenga cingana aha muhango gwa Hamati kuhika oku mugezi gw’e Mîsiri.
Oku lusiku lwa kali munâni, afundika; bulya bali bamâjira olukulu lwa okukuza oluhêrero nsiku nda.

N’omu lusiku lwa kali makumi abirhi z’omwêzi gwa kali nda, Salomoni asengaruka olubaga mpu lushubirage omu mahêma gâbo, boshi bagenda erhi bashagalusire n’omurhima gwâbo guli n’obusîme bunene kuli ago minjà Nyamubâho ajirîre Daudi, Salomini n’Israheli n’olubaga lwâge.
Okubonekerwa kuhyâhya
Salomoni amala okuyûbaka enyumpa ya Nyamubâho, n’enyumpa y’obwâmi, anajira bwinjà ngasi ebi anali abwîne omu murhima gwâge oku byo byankakwanana okujirwa oku nyumpa ya Nyamubâho n’enyumpa ya obwâmi.
Nyamubâho abonekera Salomoni budufu amubwîra erhi: «Nayumvîrhe omusengero gwâwe nanacîshozire ahâla hantu habè nyumpa yâni y’enterekêro.
“Mango nânahamike empingu n’enkuba ebula bunia, mango nanarhegeke enzige mpu ziyîshe zikanjekanje ecihugo, nîsi erhi amango nânarhume ecihûsi omu lubaga lwâni”,

“erhi olwo lubaga lwâni naderhîre kwo izîno lyâni, lwankayûnama, erhi lwankashenga lunalonza obusù bwâni, n’erhi lwankarhenga omu njira zalo ngalugalu, nanaluyumvirhiza kurhenga empingu, nanababalira ecâha câbo, nanfumye ecihugo”.
“Kurhenga ene amasù gâni gakaziyôrha gayigusire n’amarhwîri gâni gakayôrha gayumva omusengero gujirirwe muli aha hantu”.
“Bunôla, ncîshozire nangishire eyîra nyumpa lyo izîno lyâni liyôrha lirimwo ensiku zoshi, n’ahôla, amasù gâni n’omurhima gwâni byakaziyôrha bihali”.
“Nâwe, nka wakakaziyôrha wagenda bwinjà embere zâni aka sho Daudi, omu kukazijira ngasi byoshi nkurhegesire, okanalanga amarhegeko gâni n’engeso zâni”,
“nanazibuhya ishungwè ly’obwâmi bwâwe, nk’oku nanalagânanaga rhwe na sho Daudi amango naderhaga nti: Wakaziyôrha oli n’omwâna wayîma omu Israheli”.
“Ci erhi wankahinduka, erhi wankalekêrera amarhegeko n’engeso zâni nakuhâga, n’erhi wakagend’ikolera abandi ba nyamuzinda, okanakazibafukamira”,
“nanabarhenza muli eri idaho nabahâga, eyîra nyumpa nagishaga oku izîno lyâni, nanayikûla embere z’obusù bwâni, nyijire masheka na mugani omu mashanja goshi”.
“Eyîra nyumpa yalijire enyanya ntyâla, yânabà côbà ca ngasi yêshi wankanagera hôfi nayo, anakaziderha erhi carhumaga Nyamubâho ajira ecîra cihugo n’eyîra nyumpa ntyâla?”»

Kandi banamushuza mpu: «ali ebwa kubà balekerire Nyamubâho, Nyamuzinda wa b’îshe wâbo, owabarhenzagya omu cihugo c’e Mîsiri, bagendicîshwêkera oku bandi ba nyamuzinda, bakazibafukamira, banakazibakolera, co carhumire abahirakwo amabî mangana aha».
